desc:
Note : This game is not complete, expect unfinished features. Low-end devices might not run well in a full public server, consider playing in a private server, small servers, or in a Lite version. 

Version 0.15.1 (Alpha Version)

TwisterX is a simple semi sandbox tornado game designed to be playable in mid to low-end devices that is under development and currently only has 8 towns, mostly free vehicles, enhanced simple tornado style for low end devices, Thermodynamics system, and a functioning performant Weather Radar (Reflectivity & Velocity).

Controls:
Shift + C for Free cam
Press the Camera button on the top gui if your camera is stuck.

Report bugs or suggest features via our social links or the Roblox community group wall.

TwisterX is mainly developed by Fluzerify and other wonderful developers/contributers in the credits
